runtimeSettings.title: Saitunan Runtime
runtimeSettings.description: Sanya yadda Jan ke sarrafawa da sake gwada sabar MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Matsakaicin lokacin jira don amsawar kayan aikin MCP kafin lokacin ƙarewa.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Sakamakon kayan aiki mafi tsayi a cikin tattaunawar. Duk wani abu da ya wuce wannan an gyara shi kuma an yi masa alama a matsayin yanke, don haka babban sakamako ɗaya ba zai iya ƙare mahallin samfurin ba. Saita zuwa 0 don kiyaye sakamako gabaɗaya.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRouting: Mai sarrafa kayan aikin Smart MCP
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Lokacin da aka kunna, Jan yana zaɓar sabar MCP masu dacewa kafin loda kayan aikin. Kashe don ɗaukar cikakken jerin kayan aikin MCP koyaushe.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Yi amfani da ƙididdiga na ƙididdiga don kewayawa
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Lokacin da ke kunnen hanya mai wayo, gudanar da matakin da za a bi tare da keɓantaccen tsari (sau da yawa ƙarami) maimakon ƙirar taɗi. Kashe don yin amfani da samfurin taɗi mai aiki koyaushe don kewayawa.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Zaɓi mai bayarwa da samfuri a wuri ɗaya. Motoci masu nauyi ne kawai aka jera don haka tuƙi ya kasance cikin sauri da arha.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Babu samfura masu nauyi da ake samu. Ƙara ƙaramin ƙira ko saita maɓallan API a cikin Samfura.
